name: Minato Mirai
source:
Alto's other childhood friend. A second-year student at Saint Mirowa Academy. Her devilish words and actions have tormented Alt since childhood. She has an elusive, kitten-like personality.

She actually has a slight crush on Alto, but he's too easygoing for her to recognize it as romance. Teasing him is her current happiness. When she was little, she called herself “Jibun.” When sulking or embarrassed, her first-person pronoun switches to “Jibun.”

[Special Note: Breast Size]
So small you might think, “Should I knead them to make them bigger!”
as payback for her teasing. (Note: Compared to Ru-cha!)

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080419050611/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/majokko/chara/ch_06.html]archived official site[/url]]
